title_en: Furnish Your Home Gym With This Complete Multi-Function Power Cage for Just $263.48, Includes a Squat Rack, Lat Pull-Down Machine, Power Tower, Dip Bar, and More
summary_en: Squat rack, lat pull-down machine, power tower, and dip bar in one.
body_en:
Ready to set up a starter gym in your own home? Amazon is giving you a huge incentive to do so by offering the SPORTSROYALS Multi-Function Power Cage for just $263.48 with free shipping after coupon code " O9N6OVK7 ". This power cage offers a wide range of strength training exercises that should satisfy all but the swollest of body builders.
A power cage needs to be large enough to accomodate the sheer number of exercises in its repertoire, but still be compact enough to fit in most homes. Fortunately, the SPORTSROYALS model delivers; it takes up a modest 13 square feet of ground space and stands less than 8 feet tall, which means it is comfortably shorter than the average home's ceiling height. It's also relatively easy to assemble, with most reviewers stating that it can be built within a couple of hours, although the manufacturer recommends having a helping hand or two to expedite the process.
Construction wise, the SPORTSROYALS might not compare to commercial equipment, but those are designed for constant abuse day in and day out; they're heavier, they take up more space, and they can cost upwards of thousands of dollars apiece. The SPORTSROYALS power cage weighs about 150 pounds and is constructed almost entirely of metal. It boasts a respectable maximum weight capacity of 1,200 pounds including equipment.
The power cage combines a squat rack, power tower, and dip bar, but perhaps the most notable addition is the lat pull-down machine. It consists of an upper and lower pulley system with a solid steel rope that boasts a 500-pound capacity rating. Weights aren't included but the power cage does provide plenty of built-in storage options for your accessories, including space for a barbell bar and all of your Olympic weight plates.
The power cage is a solid foundation towards building out your home gym. Buy some weights, a bench, and a good cardio machine like a rower or elliptical and you'll be off that couch and running full tilt in no time.
